request.query: polynomial coefficient l1 norm sum over finite superset of support

items.name: Polynomial.sum_eq_of_subset
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] {p : Polynomial R} (f : ℕ → R → S),
  (∀ (i : ℕ), f i 0 = 0) → ∀ {s : Finset ℕ}, p.support ⊆ s → p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ s, f n (p.coeff n)

items.name: FirstOrder.Ring.mvPolynomialSupportLEEquiv
items.type:
{ι : Type u_1} →
  {κ : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_3} →
      [DecidableEq κ] →
        [inst : CommRing R] →
          [DecidableEq R] →
            (monoms : ι → Finset (κ →₀ ℕ)) → { p // ∀ (i : ι), (p i).support ⊆ monoms i } ≃ ((i : ι) × ↥(monoms i) → R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffs
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset R

items.name: Polynomial.finset_sum_coeff
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (∑ b ∈ s, f b).coeff n = ∑ b ∈ s, (f b).coeff n

items.name: MvPolynomial.sum_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {A : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] {p : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {b : (σ →₀ ℕ) → R → A}, Finsupp.sum p b = ∑ m ∈ p.support, b m (MvPolynomial.coeff m p)

items.name: Polynomial.sum_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) (f : ℕ → R → S),
  p.sum f = ∑ n ∈ p.support, f n (p.coeff n)

items.name: Polynomial.sum
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → {S : Type u_1} → [AddCommMonoid S] → Polynomial R → (ℕ → R → S) → S

items.name: Polynomial.sum_over_range
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (p : Polynomial R) {f : ℕ → R → S},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), f n 0 = 0) → p.sum f = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), f a (p.coeff a)
